name: Rogue Arena
detailed_description:
Rogue Arena is a fast-paced bullet heaven where you build powerful loadouts, reroll for upgrades, and survive 20 waves of retro pixel chaos. Pick from dozens of unique characters and hundreds of abilities to forge unstoppable builds and defeat the final boss.

    KEY FEATURES:

  • Diverse Character Roster - Several characters each offer unique traits that add distinct flavor to your experience based on your choice.

  • Hybrid Combat System - Experience the perfect blend of automated combat and utility control. Your character continuously unleashes their arsenal against enemies while you control utility abilities at your discretion - think movement, shields, and tactical support rather than direct damage.

  • Massive Customization - Choose from over 100 abilities with a wide variety of capabilities. Experiment freely and watch as your choices naturally combine into powerful, satisfying builds.

  • Character Progression - 14 stats tied to your character impact your power, providing multiple paths to strengthen your build.

  • Exciting Shop System - Spend gold between waves to purchase from over 120 items in the shop, each offering different effects to modify your character and enhance your run.

  • Item Type Synergies - Items belong to distinct categories that synergize with each other, rewarding focused builds and creating meaningful decisions about which item types to pursue

  • Varied Enemy Challenge - Face several enemy types, each with different mechanics designed to keep you on your toes and test your skills.

  • Dynamic Wave Generation - A sophisticated wave generation system ensures no two runs are ever the same, keeping every playthrough fresh and unpredictable.

  • Scalable Difficulty - Five different difficulty levels that enhance fun and challenge rather than simply adjusting numbers, making the game more interesting at every skill level.

  • Final Wave - Survive long enough to face the ultimate boss battle.

short_description: Rogue Arena is a bullet heaven arena game where you choose from diverse characters, battle waves of enemies, and build your character. Collect abilities, items, and survive increasingly difficult hordes until you face the boss in this action-packed bullet heaven with endless build possibilities.
